title: End-to-end integration test suite (transit + reader)
description: Unit and component tests pass but there are no tests that run both binaries together and verify real NNTP traffic flows end-to-end. This epic adds: a two-node local test harness (one transit, one reader), RFC 3977 conformance tests driven by slrn/tin, and a transit-to-transit propagation test. Why: integration gaps between transit and reader are the most likely source of production failures; conformance testing with real clients is required by the project spec.
